anchors.statement: The sc-compose release must deliver the entire platform matrix: the Rust CLI archive, the sc-compose, sc-sha and sc-composer-beads Python wheels, and the sc-sha-go Go module, each for macOS x64, macOS arm64, Windows x64, Windows arm64, Linux x64 and Linux arm64, distributed through all applicable channels.
anchors.quote: support of mac x64/arm, win x64/arm, linux x64/arm for rust/wheel/go distributed through all applicable channels
anchors.scope: release/publish-artifacts.toml, release/go-native-module.toml, release workflows, wheel builds; 6 platforms x 5 artifacts
anchors.deterministic_check: a manifest-vs-matrix check that every one of the 30 cells has a built artifact and channel entry

anchors.statement: CI must run the full install matrix, meaning every platform, Python version and installer cell, only in the integration test workflow that release preflight requires.
anchors.quote: I want ci running full matrix ONLY for integration test (required for preflight) NOT every sprint
anchors.summary: full matrix only in integration test
anchors.scope: GitHub workflows: sprint and pull-request CI (ci.yml) must not run the full matrix; the workflow_dispatch-only integration test workflow runs it
anchors.deterministic_check: grep the workflows: the full-matrix workflow has only workflow_dispatch triggers and ci.yml never invokes it

anchors.statement: docli must be added and used for CLI documentation generation.
anchors.quote: we need to add docli for cli documentation generation
anchors.scope: sc-compose CLI reference generation (Phase U u-6, #648)
anchors.deterministic_check: the CLI reference files are produced by docli generate from the dumped Clap model

anchors.statement: docli must be run on every publish, and stale documentation must block preflight.
anchors.quote: docli must be run every publish (stale documentation blocks preflight)
anchors.scope: release preflight of sc-compose
anchors.deterministic_check: preflight regenerates the CLI reference with docli and fails when it differs from the committed reference

anchors.statement: An extension point for repos to add custom requirements to preflight must be added as a pull request to the develop branch of sc-publish.
anchors.quote: there is not an extension point that repos can add custom requirements.  this is something that should be added as a pr to develop on sc-publish
anchors.scope: sc-publish kit, repository preflight
anchors.deterministic_check: a merged PR on sc-publish develop adds the extension point

anchors.statement: docli must be offered as an optional preflight check.
anchors.quote: docli should be offered as an optional preflight check ( i want all repos that have cli to use docli)
anchors.scope: sc-publish kit, repositories with a CLI
anchors.deterministic_check: the sc-publish kit manifest documents and implements an optional docli preflight check

anchors.statement: Variables, both tight {{key}} and padded {{ key }}, including loop-local values, must be rendered before bd.
anchors.quote: Variables rendered before bd. Tight {{key}} and padded {{ key }}, including loop-local values.
anchors.scope: advanced bead pour: sc-composer-beads and the sc-compose bead commands (render, pour, preview-pour, attach, preview-attach)
anchors.deterministic_check: render a loop with tight and padded variables and read back the text bd receives: no unrendered variable remains

anchors.statement: Values containing {{ }}, {{{ }}} or {% %} must stay data and must never be re-parsed.
anchors.quote: Values containing {{ }}, {{{ }}} or {% %} stay data and are never re-parsed.
anchors.scope: advanced bead pour: sc-composer-beads and the sc-compose bead commands (render, pour, preview-pour, attach, preview-attach)
anchors.deterministic_check: supply values containing each delimiter and read back identical literal text

anchors.statement: Filters must act on the real value, so A{BC lowercases to a{bc and has length 4.
anchors.quote: Filters act on the real value, so A{BC lowercases to a{bc and has length 4.
anchors.scope: advanced bead pour: sc-composer-beads and the sc-compose bead commands (render, pour, preview-pour, attach, preview-attach)
anchors.deterministic_check: render lower and length filters on A{BC and compare output

anchors.statement: Include defaults must be applied.
anchors.quote: Include defaults.
anchors.scope: advanced bead pour: sc-composer-beads and the sc-compose bead commands (render, pour, preview-pour, attach, preview-attach)
anchors.deterministic_check: an included template default reaches the rendered output when the caller omits it

anchors.statement: Bead inputs must be supported on graph and attach pour.
anchors.quote: Bead inputs on graph and attach pour
anchors.summary: bead inputs on graph and attach
anchors.scope: advanced bead pour: sc-composer-beads and the sc-compose bead commands (render, pour, preview-pour, attach, preview-attach)
anchors.deterministic_check: graph-mode pour and attach accept bead input values under the advanced mode

anchors.statement: bd-owned expressions must be an explicit mode.
anchors.quote: bd-owned expressions as an explicit mode
anchors.scope: advanced bead pour: sc-composer-beads and the sc-compose bead commands (render, pour, preview-pour, attach, preview-attach)
anchors.deterministic_check: bd-owned expression handling is selected only by an explicit option; the default is unchanged

anchors.statement: Blocked graph plans must be refused before bd.
anchors.quote: refusing blocked graph plans before bd
anchors.scope: advanced bead pour: sc-composer-beads and the sc-compose bead commands (render, pour, preview-pour, attach, preview-attach)
anchors.deterministic_check: a blocked graph plan produces a refusal and zero bd create calls

anchors.statement: Unsafe bead inputs must be rejected.
anchors.quote: rejecting unsafe bead inputs
anchors.scope: advanced bead pour: sc-composer-beads and the sc-compose bead commands (render, pour, preview-pour, attach, preview-attach) (definition of unsafe input pending from the user)
anchors.deterministic_check: unsafe inputs produce a typed error and zero bd calls

anchors.statement: Plan path failures must be named.
anchors.quote: naming plan path failures
anchors.scope: advanced bead pour: sc-composer-beads and the sc-compose bead commands (render, pour, preview-pour, attach, preview-attach)
anchors.deterministic_check: a failing graph plan path appears by name in the error

anchors.statement: sc-compose must not rely on bd variable substitution, which is buggy.
anchors.quote: beads variable substitution is buggy
anchors.scope: advanced bead pour: sc-composer-beads and the sc-compose bead commands (render, pour, preview-pour, attach, preview-attach)
anchors.deterministic_check: the text passed to bd is correct with no bd --var substitution

anchors.statement: The bead pour work must be added to the end of Phase U, after the upgrades.
anchors.quote: let's add it to the end of phase-u (after the upgrades)
anchors.summary: bead port at end of Phase U
anchors.scope: Phase U plan sequencing
anchors.deterministic_check: the bead sprints depend on every upgrade sprint in the plan

anchors.statement: The bead pour work must have fuzz tests at the end that confirm everything works and verify that previous fuzz test runs show no regression.
anchors.quote: it should have fuzz tests at the end to confirm everything works (and verify previous fuzz tests run have no regression).
anchors.scope: Phase U plan, final sprint
anchors.deterministic_check: the final sprint runs the earlier fuzz cases and they all pass

anchors.statement: The bead pour work must not be done by pair programming or by making undocumented decisions.
anchors.quote: I do not like pair programming and making undocumented decisions.
anchors.scope: bead pour work planning
anchors.deterministic_check: an ADR or requirement exists before each implementation sprint starts

anchors.statement: Pouring must be clearly documented, in a requirement or an ADR.
anchors.quote: pouring clearly documented (or ADR)
anchors.scope: advanced bead pour: sc-composer-beads and the sc-compose bead commands (render, pour, preview-pour, attach, preview-attach); documentation
anchors.deterministic_check: ADR-0024/FR-24 exist and describe each mode with a worked example
